name: omnifexit/omni-core
description: Code shared by the OmnifexIT services: encrypted queue jobs between services, OmniAuth SSO and the Tailscale-aware Sentinel driver.

suggest.laravel/sanctum: Required for the SSO user-revocation middleware (EnsureUserNotRevoked).
suggest.laravel/sentinel: Required for the Tailscale-aware Sentinel driver (comes with laravel/horizon).
suggest.laravel/socialite: Required for OmniAuth SSO login (OmniAuthProvider, SsoController).
suggest.spatie/laravel-data: Required for the SyncUsers job handler.
suggest.spatie/laravel-permission: Required for SSO role and permission sync (SsoController, SyncUsers, SyncRoleChange).
